title: Sweet Chilli Ginger Sauce
preamble:

red chili peppers, finely chopped
120
ml rice vinegar
1

g sugar

Method:-
Combine the chillies, sugar, water, rice vinegar, paprika, garlic and salt in a saucepan.
Bring to the boil and let simmer until the sugar dissolves and the mixture begins to thicken.
Add lime juice and simmer for another 1 minute.
Cool before serving.
